 Appearance:

 Shri Bhashkar Agrawal, learned counsel for the responden
 Order

This miscellaneous appeal under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is preferred for enhancement of compensation of Rs.1 lakh challenging the award dated 09.07.2019 in MACC No.178/2017 by MACT, Ratlam.
2.
The only issue involved in this appeal is regarding the quantum of compensation, hence the detailed facts are not being mentioned.

A total compensation of Rs.6,96,000/- was awarded for the death of Bijal in motor vehicle accident in the intervening night between 17.04.2017 & 18.04.2017 near highway in front of Rajastan- Haryana Dhaba within the jurisdiction of PS Ringnod, district Ratlam.

3. This appeal has been preferred on the ground that income has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6712 2 MA-6434-2019 been assessed on lower side
. The consortium has not been awarded to the children and mother of the deceased.
No amount has been awarded in the head of loss of estate.

4. Heard.
5.
Counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer.

6. Perused the award.
7.

The deceased was agriculturist, aged 42 years and his income has been assessed at Rs.50,000/-
per annum.

It ought to have been assessed at least Rs.5,000/- per month and 25% income ought to Smt. Gali vs Gajanand Alias Gajananda on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164349508/
1 have been added towards future prospects which comes to Rs.6,250/- per month.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the compensation is recalculated as under:
Rs.6,50,000/-
Loss of dependency (i.e Rs.5000+25% FP=6,250x12=75,000 - 1/3 PE=50000x13(M)=6,50,000/-
 Consortium Rs.1,60,000/-
 Loss of estate Rs.15,000/-
 Funeral  Rs.15,000/-
 expenses  Medical  Rs.89,000/-
 expenses  Mental &
 Rs.10,000/-
 physical agony  Total Rs.9,39,000/-
8. Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.9,39,000/- as against the award of the Tribunal of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6712 3 MA-6434-2019 Rs.6,96,000/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.2,43,000/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
9. In the result, the appeal is allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.2,43,000/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
10. The appellants have valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.1 lakh and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the remaining amount e Court fee shall be paid by the appellants within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
11. In the result, the appeal is allowed to the extent indicated herein above.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE hk/
